Privacy Policy

Last updated: 8 October 2026

Moon's Kitchen ("we", "us") runs this website, moonskitchen.netlify.app. This page explains what information we collect when you use it and what we do with it.

Browsing and ordering

You can browse the site and order without creating an account. Orders are placed on WhatsApp, where WhatsApp's own privacy policy applies to your messages.

Signing in (optional)

If you choose to sign in, we receive:

  • With Google: your name and email address, shared by Google with your permission. We do not receive your Google password or any other Google account data.
  • With an email code: the email address you enter. We send a one-time 6-digit code to it.

We use this only to keep you signed in and to recognise you on the site. We do not sell or share it with anyone for marketing.

Cookies

When you sign in we set one cookie, mk_session, which keeps you signed in for up to 30 days. Logging out removes it. We also remember your last colour theme in your browser's local storage. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.

Services we use

  • Netlify hosts the website and runs the sign-in.
  • Brevo sends the email sign-in codes.
  • Google provides "Continue with Google" sign-in.

These services process data only as needed to provide those features.

Your choices

You can log out at any time from the account menu at the top of the site. To ask about or remove any information we hold about you, email us at siddikroy1@gmail.com.
